exam_scheme.note: Assam Combined Entrance Examination (CEE) is conducted annually by the Assam Science and Technology University (ASTU) for admission into four-year Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) programmes in state engineering colleges across Assam. The examination consists of a single offline OMR-based paper of 3 hours duration (180 minutes) containing 120 multiple choice questions based on the Higher Secondary syllabus of the Assam State School Education Board (ASSEB Division-II). The marking scheme awards +4 marks for each correct response and deducts 1 mark (-1) for each incorrect response, for a total maximum score of 480 marks. Question papers are provided bilingually in English and Assamese.

competition_benchmarks.note: Statistics compiled from official admissions announcements and rank card notifications released by Assam Science and Technology University (ASTU) and the Directorate of Technical Education (DTE), Assam. Merit ranks determine seat allotment across premier state engineering institutions including Assam Engineering College (Guwahati), Jorhat Engineering College (Jorhat), JIST (Jorhat), Bineswar Brahma Engineering College (Kokrajhar), Barak Valley Engineering College (Karimganj), Golaghat Engineering College, and Dhemaji Engineering College.
